title: DiscussionMessage
description: One message on a discussion thread: a signal from an agent, a coordinator step, or a message from a person. Published on kubemoot.discuss.<namespace>.<crew>.<channel>.<threadId>, and on kubemoot.lifecycle for the waking and ready signals.

messageId.description: Unique id of this message (a UUID). A message published to two subjects carries the same id, so readers drop the second copy.

threadId.description: The thread the message belongs to. Empty on the lifecycle signals waking and ready, which belong to no thread.

agentName.description: Who sent the message: an agent's name, human for a person in the dashboard, scheduler for a scheduled follow-up, or discussion-gateway for a request the gateway could not queue.

messageType.description: What the message is. Agents send waking, ready, triaging, evaluating, waiting, heartbeat, and the terminal signals agree, concern, stand_aside and failure. The coordinator sends thread_start, advisory, advisory_ready, triage_result, review_ready, gap_detected, synthesis and thread_close, and failure on behalf of an agent that missed its deadline. Onboarding agents send proposal. People send thread_start, reply, thread_pause, thread_resume and stop_requested; the scheduler sends reminder. block is a consensus signal readers handle that no shipped agent sends.

content.description: The message text: the question on thread_start, the contribution on a signal, the answer on synthesis. Large contributions are spilled to the artifact store and the content then names the artifact.

channel.description: The channel token of the subject the message belongs to, such as broadcast or general.

timestamp.description: When the message was published, RFC 3339 in UTC. Java writers send nanosecond precision, Go writers whole seconds.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent of the span that published the message, so a trace follows a question across agents. Optional; also sent as the traceparent NATS header.

tracestate.description: W3C Trace Context tracestate that goes with traceparent.
